name: smwgraphics-juxtapose-script-font
title: "Juxtapose" Script Font
description:
Comes with three variants:
Raw - Fully compatible with vanilla SMW, with less ASCII characters (and no 8 or 9, like vanilla)
Controller - Replaces ILLUSIYELLOW and the interpunct with an assortment of button characters
Extended - Replaces many things (e.g. ILLUSIYELLOW, Yoshi's pawprint, and the italic punctuation) with more ASCII characters and logograms

Feel free to credit me if used, however it's not necessary.
